title: From the Summit to the Beach: Kilimanjaro and Zanzibar
excerpt: Summit, then sea. Here is how to plan a few days on Zanzibar after Kilimanjaro, and which beach suits tired legs best.
body:
After a week of cold nights and hard walking, a beach in the Indian Ocean sounds very good. Kilimanjaro and Zanzibar combine easily.

## How to get there

Domestic flights from Kilimanjaro Airport or Arusha to Zanzibar take about one to one and a half hours. See [from safari to Zanzibar](/blog/safari-to-zanzibar-flight/).

## How many days

Three to five nights is ideal. You have time to rest, swim and take one or two excursions without rushing. See [how many days on Zanzibar](/blog/how-many-days-zanzibar/).

## Which beach

- **North coast ([Nungwi and Kendwa](/blog/nungwi-and-kendwa/)):** swimming is possible at all tides.
- **East coast (Paje, Jambiani, Michamvi):** wide beaches, big tidal differences, quiet.
- **Stone Town:** one night for history, food and the night market.

## What to do

- Do nothing, which is fine.
- A [spice tour](/blog/zanzibar-spice-tour/).
- [Snorkelling at Mnemba](/blog/mnemba-atoll-snorkelling/).
- A [sunset dhow cruise](/blog/sunset-dhow-cruise/).

## Mountain, bush and beach

Many travellers do all three: Kilimanjaro, a short safari and Zanzibar, in about two to three weeks. [Plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
